anti_overlap: fd-ottoman-calligraphy-visual-hierarchy covers visual rhythm and reading flow. fd-swiss-watchmaking-precision-tolerance covers micro-interaction timing. fd-wayfinding-cathedral-spatial-progression covers spatial narrative sequence.
decision_lens: Does every connection between elements create structural integrity through precise fit alone, or does the page rely on hidden fasteners (trust assumptions) that a visitor cannot verify?
distance_rationale: Pre-modern Japanese wood joinery is a physical craft concerned with structural integrity through geometric precision in natural materials — maximally distant from digital marketing.
expected_isomorphisms: Both disciplines must create reliable connections between elements using only the elements themselves — no external fasteners in joinery, no pre-existing brand trust on a cold landing page.
focus: Whether the page's visual and verbal joints create load-bearing trust without visible fasteners
name: fd-japanese-joinery-structural-trust
persona: A master carpenter (miyadaiku) trained in the Nishioka lineage of Japanese temple joinery, specializing in tsugite and shiguchi joint design for load-bearing wooden structures assembled without nails, bolts, or adhesives.
review_areas: Whether the headline-to-animation joint is load-bearing: does 'Paste in rough. Get back ready.' create enough structural expectation that the diff animation below feels like its inevitable resolution, or is there a gap where the visitor must supply their own inference?

Whether the diff animation examples form a mortise-and-tenon sequence — each example should lock into the claim more tightly than the last, the way subsidiary joints reinforce a primary joint. Assess whether the 3 examples create cumulative proof or repetitive assertion.

Whether the form placement relies on invisible fasteners — the jump from 'I see what it does' to 'I will give my email' requires a trust joint. What hidden geometry (social proof, credibility signal, risk reversal) is present or absent between the animation and the form?
Whether the privacy line ('Email only. We never store your writing.') functions as a proper wedge pin — the small element that locks the entire structure against lateral force (privacy anxiety).
Whether the 4-theme easter egg (Shift+~) is a decorative inlay or a structural weakness — decorative elements in joinery must never compromise the joint.

severity_examples.condition: When all three diff examples have zero 'unchanged' words, making the animation look like wholesale rewriting rather than editorial refinement
severity_examples.scenario: The headline promises a transformation but the animation shows only deletion-then-insertion with no shared words between before/after — the visitor sees replacement, not editing.

severity_examples.condition: When fewer than one trust-building element exists between the animation region and the email input
severity_examples.scenario: No trust joint exists between the demonstration and the form — no social proof, no credibility signal, no risk mitigation.

severity_examples.condition: When all examples share identical rhetorical structure (abstract → concrete) without varying the editorial transformation type
severity_examples.scenario: The three diff examples repeat the same joint type (vague corporate → specific concrete) without variation.

source_domain: Japanese temple carpentry (miyadaiku), specifically tsugite/shiguchi joint design from the Kiwari-jutsu tradition
success_hints: The page creates trust through precise fit: each element's shape is determined by what it connects to, visitors never need to supply their own inference to bridge two sections, and the conversion ask feels like a natural continuation of the demonstration.
task_context: Single-screen waitlist landing page. Components: LandingNav, LandingHero wrapping DiffAnimation (3 editorial before/after examples), WaitlistForm (email + role dropdown + submit), ThemeSwitcher. The diff examples are defined in diff-examples.ts with word-level delete/insert/unchanged types. Currently all 3 examples have zero 'unchanged' words.
